business: ICICI Bank Limited is India's leading financial services provider offering retail, corporate and business banking. Serves customers through loans, deposits, payments, investments and wealth management products. Generates revenue through net interest margins, service fees, commissions and treasury operations.

segments.name: Retail Banking
segments.comment: Consumer loans, deposits, credit cards, insurance products

segments.name: Corporate Banking
segments.comment: Corporate lending, transaction banking, treasury services

segments.name: Business Banking
segments.comment: SME lending and comprehensive banking solutions

segments.name: Private Banking & Wealth Management
segments.comment: High-net-worth individuals' banking and investment needs

revenue_mix: India-focused with overseas coverage for India-linked business. Loan portfolio ₹15,538.93 billion; deposits ₹17,946.25 billion at March 31, 2026. Diverse customer segments across geographies and sectors.
strategy: Customer-360° approach serving complete banking needs across ecosystems and value chains
Micromarket-focused expansion with localized strategies and 7,511 business centres network
Generative AI and digital transformation for efficiency, customer service and innovation
Process simplification and decongestion to enhance customer experience and turnaround times
Strategic partnerships with fintechs, platforms and ecosystem players for growth
outlook: Profitable growth with 7.1% PBT growth in FY2026. Focus on capital preservation, asset quality (NPA at 0.33%), stable funding, and market share expansion through enhanced distribution and operational capabilities.
capex_plans: Investing in technology platforms, cybersecurity, expanded data centres, AI/ML capabilities and digital channels. Added 528 business centres in FY2026.
risks: Credit risk managed through granular portfolio with 71.9% corporate loans internally rated A- and above
Operational and cyber risks requiring strengthened cybersecurity and data privacy measures
Liquidity risk managed through stable funding profile and growing deposit franchise
Regulatory and compliance risk in evolving banking and technology landscape
flags: Related party transactions with ICICI Prudential Life Insurance and ICICI Lombard (subsidiaries) and India Infradebt Limited (associate) for FY2028 being approved at 32nd AGM. Multiple executive compensation revisions and director re-appointments.
